name: shure-wireless (EXPERIMENTAL FORK)
description: EXPERIMENTAL community fork of the Shure Wireless module. AD4D, AD4Q and ANX4 run on an ACN driver tested on real hardware; also adds PSM1000 and SLX-D+ and various fixes not present in the officially bundled module. Not affiliated with or supported by Bitfocus or Shure. Installs alongside the bundled Shure Wireless module under its own id (shure-wireless-mbsound).
